messages:
June Li: hey all! June here, joining runtime infra as an SRE-ish engineer. excited to meet everyone :wave: pronouns she/her. tiny fun fact: I collect vintage mechanical keyboards. any first-day must-dos?
Omar Reyes: welcome June :tada: i'm your onboarding buddy. first-day checklist: confirm laptop & okta, add SSH key, and join 4pm "runtime intro". i'll DM you repo access.
June Li: thanks Omar! i'm on Linux. where's the bootstrap script?
Ava Martin: welcome! clone https://github.com/redwood-inference/dev-setup then run `./bootstrap.sh --linux`. if you run into slow container downloads, try `./bootstrap.sh --mirror`.
June Li: perfect. who do I ask about a short-lived GPU for local experiments?
Omar Reyes: ping #eng-infra or DM @infra on this thread. infra usually grants a dev GPU (1-2 weeks) after a quick justification. DM me and i'll walk you through the request.
infra-bot: [system] created invite: "Runtime intro — new hire" tomorrow 4:00pm PT.
people-ops-bot: [system] welcome June! Please complete the new-hire form: https://hr.redwood.example/new-hire-form and upload a headshot.
June Li: quick question: where are runbooks and the oncall rota?
Ava Martin: runbooks in eng-sre/docs/runbooks (repo). oncall rota is in the shared drive and the #eng-oncall pinned message links it.
June Li: awesome. also — preferred channel for quick design questions?
Omar Reyes: use #eng-runtime for async questions, DM for 1:1. for design reviews open a draft PR and add @eng-runtime reviewers + tag "design-review".
June Li: gotcha. last thing: team rituals/food? i'm allergic to tree nuts.
Ava Martin: we do pairing Thursdays and a Friday team lunch every other week. snacks in the kitchen are nut-free, but shout out allergies in the office form.
June Li: thanks! and happy to bring a keyboard demo if people want to geek out :stuck_out_tongue_winking_eye: 
Omar Reyes: please do — keyboard show-and-tell sounds perfect for a Friday!
welcome-bot: [system] June Li added to #new-hires and #eng-runtime. Onboarding checklist: 1/6 complete (accounts created).
people-ops-bot: [system] equipment pickup scheduled for tomorrow.
June Li: copying notes here into my onboarding doc. thanks for the warm welcome everyone :rocket:
